findings: The pixels show supermarket shelves of packaged beans, lentils and other dried staples. The scene fits the retained source description of Papaya Supermarket in Dearborn, Michigan. There are no depicted people or implied interview subjects.

The retained Commons record identifies USDAgov, a USDA source Flickr page, a passed Public Domain Mark review and the PD-USGov-USDA tag. The original JPEG, rights record and retained public-domain policy hashes all match their supplied bindings.

The provider's depicted date and the JPEG's nested DateTimeOriginal both identify June 22, 2023. The filename contains June 21; it is an object identifier, not authority to change the depicted date. Public captioning at June 2023 is appropriate.

The existing caption clearly marks archive context and excludes a September 2026 price observation. Its credit identifies USDAgov / U.S. Department of Agriculture, Wikimedia Commons and public-domain status. Keep that canonical credit and the source/license links.
The photo illustrates a consumer-basket setting only. It neither establishes a 2026 price level nor corroborates any CPI figure or energy contribution.
evidence_notes: JPEG DateTimeOriginal is 2023:06:22 10:31:28. Its separate file DateTime is 2023:08:28 08:46:44; the latter is not the depicted date.

The embedded OffsetTimeOriginal is -08:00 while the retained Commons date representation uses Z. This review does not reconcile an exact capture clock. The public month-level archive caption is unchanged and does not depend on that offset.
